messages:
maria.g: ACMEEdge asked if we can surface one "Cloud+Edge Bundle" row in the marketplace CSV instead of two separate SKUs. They need seat allocation and a device-hours breakdown.

raj.patel: We currently emit hosted_tokens and onprem_hours rows. CSV contract doesn't support nested JSON.

marketplace-bot: NOTE: CSV v3 has no nested fields.

david_k: Proposal: emit one bundle CSV row with bundle_id, total_units, breakdown_ref_url, signature. Publish signed breakdown JSON to S3 with component SKUs and seat_allocations.

sarah-ops: Ops will run nightly verification: fetch breakdown, verify signature against partner pubkey, validate totals. Alert if mismatch >0.5% or seat rounding >1.

maria.g: OK. Raj will draft breakdown schema and deterministic bundle_usage_id (sha256(partner|date|sku|seq)). Timeline: prototype in staging by Thu, partner demo Fri. I'll update the PRD and loop in legal for tolerance wording.
